data.title: Collect Information with Forms
data.outcome: Choose the right input controls, reduce entry errors, and confirm whether data was actually submitted.

stages.title: Choose the right input for each question
stages.action: Decide for each field whether it needs free text, one choice, multiple choices, or a fixed list.
stages.evidence: Every field uses a control that matches the question the user needs to answer.

lessons.title: Input
lessons.tagline: Let the user enter one line of text

lessons.title: Textarea
lessons.tagline: Let the user enter several lines of text

lessons.title: Radio
lessons.tagline: Choose exactly one option from a small set

lessons.title: Checkbox
lessons.tagline: Choose one, several, or none of the options

lessons.title: Select
lessons.tagline: Choose one value from a collapsed list

stages.title: Tell users what to enter and why
stages.action: Add visible labels, needed instructions, and required-field markers.
stages.evidence: Users can understand every field without relying on placeholder text.

lessons.title: Label
lessons.tagline: Visible text that tells people what a form control asks for

lessons.title: Form
lessons.tagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

stages.title: Point out specific errors at the right time
stages.action: Validate fields and place errors next to the fields that need attention.
stages.evidence: Each error explains the problem, and users can submit after fixing it.

lessons.title: Validation
lessons.tagline: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

stages.title: Make the submission process and result visible
stages.action: Handle duplicate-submission prevention, waiting, success, and failure.
stages.evidence: Users can confirm that the data was submitted, rather than only seeing the button change.

lessons.title: Spinner
lessons.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

lessons.title: Result
lessons.tagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step

lessons.title: Toast
lessons.tagline: Briefly confirm a small action that just finished
